subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
(b)  EXA Ltd. operates a standard costing system for controlling its material costs
and has furnished the following information for the month of April, 2026:
Standard Price of raw material
` 30 per Kg
Standard Quantity of material required per unit of
output
5 kgs.

COST AND MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTING

9
Standard labour rate
` 50 per hour
Standard labour requirement
2.5 hours per unit
Actual Output
2000 units
Material Price Variance
` 1,75,000 (Adverse)
Actual Quantity of raw material purchased and
consumed
14,000 kgs.
Actual wages paid for 6,000 hours
` 3,24,000
You are required to calculate:
(i)  Actual price per kg of raw material
(ii)  Material usage variance
(iii)  Material cost variance
(iv)  Labour rate variance
(v)  Labour efficiency variance
(Indicate the nature of variance Favourable (F) or Adverse (A))
(5 Marks)
suggested_answer:
(b)  Workings:
1.  Standard Quantity for actual output
= 2,000 x 5 kg = 10,000 kg
2.  Standard Labour Hours for actual output  = 2,000 x 2.5 hours per unit

= 5,000 hours
3.  Actual Labour Rate

= ` 3,24,000/6,000 hours

COST AND MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTING

11

= ` 54
(i)  Actual Price Per Kg
Material Price Variance
= (SP - AP) x AQ

Material Price Variance
= ` 1,75,000 (A)

Therefore:

(30 - AP) x 14,000

= -1,75,000

Actual Price

= ` 42.5
(ii)  Material Usage Variance= (SQ - AQ) x SP

= (10,000 – 14,000) x ` 30

= ` 1,20,000 (A)
(iii)  Material Cost Variance  = SQ x SP - AQ X AP

= 10,000 x ` 30 – 14,000 x ` 42.5

= ` 2,95,000 (A)
(iv)  Labour Rate Variance
= (SR - AR) X AH

= (` 50 - ` 54) x 6000

= ` 24,000 (A)
(v) Labour Efficiency Variance= (SH - AH) X SR

= (5,000 – 6,000) x ` 50

= ` 50,000 (A)
